projects.description: Cleaned, validated, and integrated relational Olist tables into a star-schema model, enabling consistent analysis of revenue, customers, delivery performance, reviews, and payments in Power BI. Analyzed 96,478 delivered orders and 93,358 customers; found that 6.77% of SLA-evaluated orders were late and averaged approximately 2.3 in review score, versus above 4.0 for on-time or early deliveries, supporting delivery‑risk monitoring and logistics improvements. Validated Power BI measures against Python-generated KPI reports to verify metric definitions and maintain consistent results across dashboards and analytical outputs. Developed an interactive Power BI dashboard to present revenue, customer, delivery, review, and payment KPIs through drill‑down analysis and business‑focused visualizations.
impact_metrics: Average review score approx 2.3 vs >4.0 for on‑time deliveries
projects.name: Olist E-commerce Analytics and Delivery Performance

projects.description: Analyzed 1,000 credit applications across 21 variables and quantified an overall 30% bad‑credit rate through data validation, segmentation, and comparative risk analysis. Identified the highest‑risk customer and loan segments based on differences in bad‑credit rates across key variables. Developed an interactive Power BI dashboard that enabled side‑by‑side comparison of bad‑credit rates across customer and loan segments.
impact_metrics: Identified highest‑risk customer and loan segments
projects.name: German Credit Risk Analysis
